meta.payments_rule: Transaction lines of $1,000 or more in purchasing categories, as posted (gross). A line is left out when a credit or reversal of the same amount to the same payee cancels it; smaller credits are not matched, so the lines can add up to more than the net yearly total. Descriptions that may identify a person are withheld.
